description: We are CosmoHealthX,a team passionate about space medicine and astronaut health. Our mission is to explore the challenges astronauts face during space missions and develop innovative ideas to support their physical and mental well-being. We aim to contribute to making space exploration safer and healthier for future generations.
summary:
CosmoHealthX is a digital platform designed to monitor astronauts’ health during space missions. Space environments create challenges such as radiation exposure, sleep disturbances, cardiovascular changes, bone density loss, and psychological stress.

Our platform brings key health indicators together in one dashboard, including heart rate, sleep duration, radiation awareness, bone density, and stress assessment. It presents health data through clear visualizations, helping users understand potential risks and monitor changes over time.

CosmoHealthX aims to improve health awareness, support astronaut well-being, and contribute to safer and more sustainable human space exploration.
details:
Our team developed CosmoHealthX by combining research, creative problem-solving, and AI-assisted development. We used AI tools to explore design ideas, structure health-monitoring features, organize project information, and improve our prototype.

Our development approach follows a workflow: data collection, analysis, identification of unusual changes, and personalized recommendations. We also designed a visual traffic-light alert system to make potential health risks easier to recognize.

What makes CosmoHealthX unique is its integration of physical and psychological health indicators in one astronaut-focused platform. Our goal is to make complex health information accessible through an intuitive interface and intelligent digital solutions.
